history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a graphic print of the United States map on the back and a black baseball cap with the word "SANCH" in white letters, stands facing away from the camera, looking to his right. He is wearing loose-fitting black pants. The background features a grey stone wall covered with lush green hanging plants. To his left is a red fire hydrant with blue accents, adorned with stickers. To his right is a bright red utility box covered in layers of torn posters and graffiti, featuring splashes of red, blue, and black spray paint. The lighting appears to be from a low-angle, artificial source, creating some shadows and highlighting the textures of the wall and the graffiti. The overall mood is urban and slightly gritty, with a focus on street style and urban elements. The color palette is dominated by the green of the plants, the grey of the wall, the red of the hydrant and utility box, and the black and white of the man's clothing and cap. The image has a slightly desaturated, cinematic quality.
